explication: AstroCommunity is a catalog of community-contributed plugin configuration specifications for AstroNvim, not a standalone plugin runtime. The main workflow is for a user to import a specification in their AstroNvim plugin setup, then customize or disable it through their own plugin definitions. The tree shows a broad catalog spanning editor features, language support, workflows, and ready-made recipes. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships beyond those explicitly described in the README are omitted.
